beats: Cast rule (episodes/e01-moe/FACTS.md: an expert is not a topic specialist; never label one by subject): the receptionist plus eight doctors told apart only by face and hair, no specialty props; the film numbers the doors in code (#0-#255), never names a department.

Hook: some experts get picked again and again, some always together; a system that knew their habits could plan for them (line_moe_doctor_pair; line_moe_desire_path). Check: the syllabus hook says "seat them side by side", but the lecture says split a pair across GPUs so one GPU is not swamped; script it the lecture's way.

The decode squeeze: attention is memory-bound (every patient's long file fills the lobby, so few fit), while experts need big batches: with about 10% of the experts active, a batch of about 2,000 gives each about 200 (line_moe_decode_cutaway).
Split them (disaggregation): attention and experts in separate buildings, each scaled on its own, cheaper hardware for the memory-bound half (line_moe_two_buildings_bridge).
MegaScale-Infer: disaggregated attention and experts, a ping-pong pipeline (two micro-batches in flight, so neither side waits) and M-to-N messaging (line_moe_ping_pong).
Watching the habits (the lab's own paper, arXiv 2510.05497): profile which experts get picked (line_moe_habit_watcher; reuse line_tally_pages).

Habits in time: layer to layer (Ob1: the top 20% of pairs make 40-80% of the counts), token to token (Ob2: neighbours pick the same expert, more so in higher layers), prefill predicts decode (Ob3: top-5 overlap above 60%): the worn shortcut across the lawn (line_moe_desire_path), patients following one another through one door (line_moe_follow_leader). Use: prefetch and cache, the specialist is ready before you arrive (line_moe_doctor_waiting_door).

Habits in space: uneven (Ob4: the busiest experts get about 20x the average), shifting with the subject, yet a few stay busy for every subject (line_moe_topic_patients; show subjects only, no scripts or languages on screen; a statistical lean, not a department); some experts come in pairs (Ob5: line_moe_doctor_pair; reuse line_paired_cards), so put the two in different rooms to keep one GPU from being swamped (line_moe_pair_two_rooms).

Takeaways (slide 47): sparse activation scales capacity, not compute; balance (aux loss, then bias); EP + all-to-all, disaggregated attention and experts; habits for smarter systems. Season finale for the lab: the traces are open (reuse line_moe_all_doors_busy / line_moe_oncall_bunks from the L14-01/02 plans, line_block_towers).
